steps.title: Prepare BTSC growth medium
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL of brain‑tumor stem cell (BTSC) growth medium by adding to DMEM/F12 the following supplements to the final concentrations indicated: B‑27 (1 X), GlutaMAX 2 mM, penicillin 100 U/mL, streptomycin 100 µg/mL, HEPES 5 mM, heparin 2 µg/mL, human EGF 20 ng/mL, and human FGF 20 ng/mL. Mix thoroughly to a total volume of ~50 mL.

steps.title: Store and equilibrate medium
steps.instruction: Store the prepared BTSC growth medium (with EGF and FGF) at 4 °C. Before use, bring it to 19–21 °C for ~1 h, or warm in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min. Use fresh medium within 2 weeks because growth factors are unstable.

steps.title: Prepare mitochondrial modulator stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions (store at –20 °C, stable ≥6 months) and aliquot to avoid freeze‑thaw cycles:

substeps.instruction: Oligomycin: dissolve 5 mg oligomycin in 316 µL DMSO to obtain a 20 mM stock.
FCCP: dissolve 10 mg FCCP in 393 µL DMSO to obtain a 100 mM stock.
Antimycin A: dissolve 25 mg antimycin A in 911.25 µL DMSO to obtain a 50 mM stock.
Rotenone: dissolve 20 mg rotenone in 1014.1 µL DMSO to obtain a 50 mM stock.
If the actual powder amount differs from the listed amount, adjust the DMSO volume proportionally to reach the target concentration.

steps.title: Make 1000× working solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock solutions in DMSO to generate 1000× working solutions for the assay. Aliquot the final working solutions into 10 µL portions.

substeps.instruction: Oligomycin working solutions: 1 mM (5 µL stock + 95 µL DMSO), 2 mM (10 µL + 90 µL), 4 mM (20 µL + 80 µL).
FCCP working solutions: 1 mM (1 µL stock + 99 µL DMSO), 3 mM (3 µL + 97 µL), 6 mM (6 µL + 94 µL).
Rotenone‑antimycin A mix working solutions: 0.5 mM (1 µL rotenone + 1 µL antimycin A + 98 µL DMSO), 1 mM (2 µL each + 96 µL DMSO), 2 mM (4 µL each + 92 µL DMSO).

steps.title: Set up Resipher system
steps.instruction: Configure the Resipher hardware and software as follows:

substeps.instruction: Place the Resipher Hub on or near the humidified cell‑culture incubator (37 °C, 5 % CO₂).
Connect the Hub to a power outlet and attach an Ethernet cable to its Ethernet port (wired connection preferred).
Insert the Resipher device (with sensing lid) inside the incubator.
Run a USB‑C cable from the Resipher device (through the incubator opening) to one of the eight USB‑C ports on the external Hub.
On a workstation, open the Lucid Lab web application (https://lab.lucidsci.com/), create an account, and configure your experiment to monitor oxygen consumption in real time.
